g7.fits: g7_cn_stealth_dropship / g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl, craft centre (sprite pivot) at the pad centre (0, 0), nose +u to +2.45, ramp foot at -2.45, fans at (+1.32, +-1.11) and (-0.6, +-1.78) tiles (DL7-3)

g7_detail_level.budget_basis: packed atlas bytes (cells cropped to opaque rect, rows 2/6/7 mirrored when allowed)
g7_detail_level.mask: soldiers: armband on both upper arms + leader helmet band; vehicles/air: roof ID panel + side chevrons + hull stripe; Machine: plating trim
g7_detail_level.outline: selective: lit side = material deep tone, shadow side = pix.OUTLINE
g7_detail_level.palette: 5-tone hue-shifted ramp per material [deep, shade, mid, lit, glint]; light upper-left; muted military palettes
g7_detail_level.scale: ONE real-world scale: 4 m per 64x32 tile, 9.8 px per metre of height (1.8 m soldier = 18 px)
g7_detail_level.shading: per-pixel lit volumes; hull bevels, panel seams, rivets, grime band, chipped-paint wear

g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl.bay_open: rev4: APC parked in the lit bay seen through the open rear door (no cutaway)
g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl.cargo: 1 strike APC (g7_cn_strike_apc, 8.0 x 2.9 m = 2.0 x 0.73 tiles) + 10 seated soldiers
g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl.depth: per-pixel z-buffer (M.render_z): cargo / soldiers hidden wherever the hull is in front

g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl_apcload.depth: per-pixel z-buffer (M.render_z): cargo / soldiers hidden wherever the hull is in front
g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl_apcload.note: apc_load_0: APC on the ground lined up behind the craft, front wheels at the ramp foot; _5: parked in the bay (= bay_open). Unload: apc_unload_i = apc_load_(5-i) (reverses down the ramp)
g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl_apcload.pivot_note: same world point as the main sheet pivot (craft origin); wider cell for the APC behind the ramp

g7_a_vtol_dropship_xl_squadload.depth: per-pixel z-buffer (M.render_z): cargo / soldiers hidden wherever the hull is in front
